name: services/apisrv/now
description:
Get the current USOS API time. Your application might call it
	periodically in order to determine time offset of our clocks.
	Exact timing matters in some cases (like when a registration
	starts).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A DateTime string (first 19 characters), followed by a dot and a 6-digit fractional part of a second ("yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.dddddd"). This represents the current USOS API server local time (all DateTime strings API methods return are in local time, unless stated otherwise).
